release.releaseNotes:
Private update for Bob (Build 125 - Speedometer Digital Readout Relocation).
• Value Relocation: Moved the retained messages count and label to the upper quadrant above the center pivot hub (under 800/1200).
• Clear Cockpit Hierarchy: Dial face open below the pivot hub with the primary value prominently visible at top center.
• Realistic Speedometer: 3D tapered needle, numeric range scale, ambient backlit gradient light, and redline zone.
